title: Studying at ITS — Building Real Things
description: Currently pursuing Informatics Engineering at ITS under FTEIC. University gave me the theoretical foundation — algorithms, data structures, operating systems — but the real growth happens when I apply those concepts to actual projects.

title: Cryptography, AI & System Design
description: Built Cryptid, a CLI cryptographic toolkit using AES-256-GCM and Argon2id — my first serious attempt at security-first design. Explored AI agent architecture by building a hierarchical memory system with reflection engines.

title: Building Projects & Finding My Stack
description: Created RPG-Game — a terminal RPG that taught me more about OOP, debugging, and code review than any tutorial could. Built QRGen and NoteApp to solve real problems I had. Switched to Linux as my daily driver.

title: Learning Beyond Python
description: After getting comfortable with Python, I started exploring other languages — Go for its simplicity and concurrency, Rust for its safety guarantees, C# for its type system, and JavaScript for the web.

title: Curiosity During the Pandemic
description: Like a lot of people, I had extra time during COVID-19. Instead of just scrolling, I got curious — how do apps actually work? That curiosity led me to my first programming language: C#.
